spanish: Y guardarán mis estatutos y mis juicios, que hará a ellos el adam y vivirá en ellos; yo Jehová.

findings.issue: הָאָדָם is a common noun with the article, not a proper name; “adam” leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: 2mp guardarán matches the ustedes form; remaining tokens match in number, person, and participants.
